1.w: Give thanks to the Lord, for he is good, for his loyal love endures.

2.w: Give thanks to the God of gods, for his loyal love endures.

3.w: Give thanks to the Lord of lords, for his loyal love endures.

4.w: To the one who performs magnificent, amazing deeds all by himself, for his loyal love endures.

5.w: To the one who used wisdom to make the heavens, for his loyal love endures.

6.w: To the one who spread out the earth over the water, for his loyal love endures.

7.w: To the one who made the great lights, for his loyal love endures,

8.w: the sun to rule by day, for his loyal love endures,

9.w: the moon and stars to rule by night, for his loyal love endures.

10.w: To the one who struck down the firstborn of Egypt, for his loyal love endures,

11.w: and led Israel out from their midst, for his loyal love endures,

12.w: with a strong hand and an outstretched arm, for his loyal love endures.

13.w: To the one who divided the Red Sea in two, for his loyal love endures,

14.w: and led Israel through its midst, for his loyal love endures,

15.w: and tossed Pharaoh and his army into the Red Sea, for his loyal love endures.

16.w: To the one who led his people through the wilderness, for his loyal love endures.

17.w: To the one who struck down great kings, for his loyal love endures,

18.w: and killed powerful kings, for his loyal love endures,

19.w: Sihon, king of the Amorites, for his loyal love endures,

20.w: Og, king of Bashan, for his loyal love endures,

21.w: and gave their land as an inheritance, for his loyal love endures,

22.w: as an inheritance to Israel his servant, for his loyal love endures.

23.w: To the one who remembered us when we were down, for his loyal love endures,

24.w: and snatched us away from our enemies, for his loyal love endures.

25.w: To the one who gives food to all living things, for his loyal love endures.

26.w: Give thanks to the God of heaven, for his loyal love endures!
